arguments.script: AudioFeedbackValidation.Run(); var field=typeof(GameplayAudio).GetMethod("NaturalClip",System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static|System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic); string[] cues={"gate","locked","platform_warn","platform_fall","growth_start","growth_end","strength_start","strength_end","warning","enemy_ghost","spawn","pause","resume","complete","fall_wind"}; foreach(var cue in cues){ var path=(string)field.Invoke(null,new object[]{cue}); if(path!=cue || UnityEngine.Resources.Load<UnityEngine.AudioClip>("NaturalAudio/"+path)==null) throw new System.Exception("Unmapped cue "+cue); } return new { validated=19, cueRoutes=15, scene=UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name, dirty=UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().isDirty };
